Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value From activities Join assays On activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id Join target_dictionary On assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid Join molecule_dictionary On activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Where target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL233' And assays.assay_type = 'B' And target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' And target_dictionary.tax_id = '9606' And activities.standard_relation = '=' And activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null And activities.bao_endpoint = 'IC50' Order By molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id Limit 1000
